rationale: Both largely miss the two GT reviewers' repeated 'test try/except masks failures → false CI green' concern and mostly surface fresh (plausible but non-overlapping) findings rather than the specific human concerns. Y's CI-lane-collection finding (test-ready.yml/test-merge.yml never collecting the execution test) closely mirrors wtomin/yenuo26's marker-for-L1-inclusion concern and is backed by direct code quotes with line numbers, giving it better recall and grounding. X pads its review with narrative 'I queried the repos'/'timed on this box'/'simulated the selector' claims bearing specific commit hashes and benchmark numbers that are not derivable from the diff and read as fabricated, which hurts precision even though the underlying code-quality points (unpinned version, per-layer reload, duplication) are reasonable. Y also supplies concrete ```suggestion diffs for most findings, matching the GT reviewers' own convention, making it more directly actionable.
